lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the property used to give HUD grid items a name.

Make sure to type grid-area.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the missing HUD area name.

Make sure to type hud-ammo.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
How many grid rows do we create using this HUD code?

OneTwoThree

Make sure to pick One.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
Create a HUD grid row where the first area is empty.

Make sure to pick ..

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the HUD grid rows so that the second row has two HUD items.

Make sure to pick "hud-score hud-ammo".

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
To create game UI sections, add the classes hud-top, hud-right, game-view and hud-bottom to the grid container child elements.

Make sure to pick hud-top followed by hud-right and then game-view, hud-bottom.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add the hud-top and hud-right values to the correct properties and rules.

Make sure to pick grid-area followed by hud-top and then grid-area, hud-right.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the grid-template-areas value so that the top HUD spans across three columns.

Make sure to type hud-top hud-top hud-top.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the grid so that it contains a hud-right that spans across one column on the right side of the game view.

Make sure to pick game-view, followed by game-view, and finally hud-right.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the game view span across all three columns.

Make sure to pick " followed by game-view and then game-view, game-view, ".

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
Use justify-items to align HUD grid items to their right edge of the grid area.

Make sure to pick end.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which property does the HUD grid have?

justify-items: center;justify-items: middle;justify-items: stretch;

justify-items: center;.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the HUD grid items to occupy the entire grid area along the column axis.

Make sure to pick align-items, followed by stretch.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which property does the HUD grid have?

align-items: end;justify-items: end;align-items: stretch;

align-items: end;.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the value that aligns HUD grid items to the center of the grid column axis.

Make sure to type center.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which layout is ideal for creating a game HUD in two dimensions?

Grid layoutFlex layoutBlock layout

Grid layout.

lessons.title: Lesson #17
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which layout is ideal for aligning the contents inside a HUD panel?

Flexbox layoutGrid layoutBlock layout

Flexbox layout.

lessons.title: Lesson #18
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the classes so that the second UI item becomes a flex container.

Make sure to pick grid-container, followed by article.

lessons.title: Lesson #19
lessons.interactiveContent:
Use the ideal property and value to define the structure of the game UI so that there are three rows and one column.

Make sure to pick grid-template followed by repeat and then (, 3,, 1fr, ), 1fr.

lessons.title: Lesson #20
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the article class display as a column and center the flex items inside the container.

Make sure to pick column, followed by center, and finally center.
